prompt: Complete EspressoMachine, which HAS both a WaterTank and a BeanHopper. Each cup needs 60 ml and 8 g, and a cup is only started when both supplies can cover it.
explanation: A class can compose more than one collaborator; the machine coordinates the tank and the hopper without either of them knowing about the other. Checking both levels before taking anything is what stops a half-finished cup from swallowing water it can never pair with beans. The loop brews one cup at a time and stops as soon as either supply runs short, returning how many cups it actually managed.
hints: Keep a WaterTank field and a BeanHopper field, both created in the constructor.
Loop while you still owe cups AND tank.level() >= 60 AND hopper.level() >= 8; take from both inside the loop.
Never call take() on one supply before you know the other can pay too.
